preview: SAP Labs India interview experience for the 2023 Summer Internship, detailing four rounds including an online coding assessment, two technical rounds, and an HR round.
content: SAP Labs Interview Experience For 2023 Summer Internship (On-campus) Ayusha Vinayak Jagtap | B.Tech CS [2021-2025 Batch] SAP Labs India is SAP's largest Research and Development centre outside its headquarters in Germany. It has one of the best and most used ERP software and cloud computing service in the world. Eligibility criteria: 70 % or 7 CGPA and above in current graduating degree and 60% in 10th & 12th Job location: Bangalore/Pune/Mumbai/Gurgaon Round 1: Online Coding Round It was held on 8th November at 6:00 pm and was of 45 min duration. It was SHL Proctored and had support for all the major languages with IDE. It had 2 easy level coding questions for me, but for some other people it had medium level questions as well. Switching between questions was allowed. Both questions were in a story format with a lot of unnecessary details, so choosing what is relevant, i.e., input format, required operations on input and output format is important. 1. A list of N space separated numbers was given and we have to print the list of N space separated numbers such that all the odd numbers of the list come after the even numbers. Similar to - https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/problems/segregate-even-and-odd-numbers4629/1?itm_source=geeksforgeeks&itm_medium=article&itm_campaign=bottom_sticky_on_article just had to be run a loop and go on adding all the even numbers first and then all the odd numbers in the answer list. 2. A list of N space separated numbers was given and we had to return a list obtained by replacing the values of the numbers with their corresponding index values in the input list. Similar to –https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/rearrange-array-arrj-becomes-arri-j/ I passed all the test cases of both the questions in around 25 min. Round 2: Technical Interview I 20 students were selected for this round. It was conducted on Microsoft Teams Platform from 9 am onwards on 21st November. It lasted for around 35 min for me.My interview was scheduled at 9 am. • The interviewer was very kind and first he asked me to be comfortable and he told me that if I am not comfortable with any of the questions asked, I can frankly inform him.He said that it is not necessary that you know everything. • Then he asked me to introduce myself and he seemed impressed with my introduction.He did not ask to tell me about my projects. • Later he said that he would ask me DSA questions and started with the basic question, i.What are data structures? ii.Which data structures are you familiar with? iii.What is difference between Array and Linked List? iv.Which data structure did you use in your project?( to which I replied as array) v.Later he asked me that if there exist some data in the array I want to increase the size of array to store more data what should I do? (to which I replied we cannot increase the size of array once declared So, I have to create a new array of new required size and then copy the original data and then store new data which is drawback of array over linked list) vi.He asked me if I knew DFS and BFS. vii.What is difference between DFS and BFS? vii.What is time complexity and why is it considered while designing any software in the industry? viii.What is pascal’s triangle? Later he proceeded to ask OOPs questions: i. What are the pillars of oops? ii. Explain what is inheritance. iii. What is the difference between abstract classes and interfaces? iv. What is polymorphism and its types.(I was asked lots of counter questions on the same.) Later he asked some OS questions v. What is operating system? vi. What are the types of operating systems and which is your favourite operating system? vii. What are functions of operating system? Later he asked some DBMS questions i. He asked me difference between SQL and NoSQL databases. ii. Later he said let’s move to my favourite topic MongoDB as I have used MongoDB database in my projects.He asked me why did I use MongoDB in my projects? Later he asked me about exception handling and how is final keyword used in exception handling.(I was not known to the concept of exception handling in depth and I informed the interviewer that I am not sure about final keyword’s use in exception handling but I just illustrated about the method overriding control during runtime polymorphism to which he seemed satisfied.) Around 17 students were shortlisted for Round 3 which was again a technical Interview. Round 3: Technical Interview II It was again conducted on Microsoft Teams Platform on the same day post lunch. It lasted for around 40 min for me.It was scheduled at 10:30 am. • The interviewer introduced herself and I was again asked to introduce myself and describe all my projects. • The interviewer asked me to share my screen and open a word document. • DSAs: She asked me to write few numbers and asked me to type the bubble sort alogorithm and apply the algorithm to the numbers which she had given previously.I explained the algorithm along with time complexity and she seemed satisfied. • OOPs: i. What is OOPL? ii. What are pillars of oops and explain each pillar. iii. What is difference between abstract class and interface? iv. Can we instantiated abstract class and interface? v. Does the interfaces contain contructors and Why? • DBMS: i. What are DDL and DML commands? ii. What is the difference between Delete,Drop and Truncate? iii. Which are DDL and DML commands from the above three commands. iv. Which of the above three commands can be rolled back? v. What is prequesite for UNION command? vi. If I want the duplicate entries after union of two tables which command should I use?(UNION ALL) vii. Later she asked me to draw two tables in the word doc and asked me about the queries on joins. She asked me that she is done with everything and if I had anything to ask..(Always ask a question) Round 4: HR Interview 12 students were selected for this round. It was conducted on Microsoft Teams Platform again on the same day at 3:00 PM. It was about 10 min long The interviewer was vey friendly and she asked me to introduce myself and she asked me to explain any project.I used STAR approach to explain the project. Later she asked me if my project was deployed.She asked me about my family background and about my hometown and asked me if I was fine with any location. Finally, she asked me if I had any questions for her (again I asked her one). The results were out at 11:35 PM and 7 students were finally selected for internship opportunity and fortunately I was one of them. Resources used: • DSA: Geek for Geeks, Love Babbar 450 DSA cracker, Aditya Verma Playlist (for DP),Take you forward(for graphs) • OS: Gate Smashers Playlist, Geek for Geeks, Love Babbar sheet • OOPS: Love Babbar sheet, InterviewBit • DBMS: Love Babbar sheet, InterviewBit • Puzzles: Geek for Geeks Tips: • Always stick to limited resources and there are many resources available and we get overwhelmed sometimes but trust your preparation. • Have a friend or group of friends where you can discuss frequently asked interview questions as it helps a lot in preparation. • Always stay hydrated during the interview process and don’t panic stay calm. • Be prepared with your introduction and keep it crisp and you can highlight the things you are confident with in your introduction. • Be confident while answering the questions and if you don’t know anything don’t answer the question and inform it to interviewer.It’s fine because one person cannot know everything. • Interviewer give lots of hints. • Explain your thought process and do not remain quiet for longer duration of time.Go on interacting. • Don’t loose your hopes if you are rejected from an interview there would be many more opportunities further. All the best!!
